name: What is pool resurfacing and why is it necessary?

mainEntity.name: What is pool resurfacing and why is it necessary?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pool resurfacing involves applying a new finish to the interior surface of your swimming pool. Over time, pool surfaces can become rough, stained, or crack due due to chemical exposure, weather, and normal wear. Resurfacing not only restores the aesthetic appeal of your pool but also helps prevent leaks, improves water quality, and extends the lifespan of the pool structure. It is a vital maintenance step for preserving the integrity and enjoyment of your investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pool resurfacing applies a new finish to the interior surface, restoring appearance, preventing leaks, and extending the pool's lifespan.
